messages:
elaine_sales: FYI customer has a hard requirement: keys must be rotated every 30 days and the KMS must be customer-managed (BYOK). asking if our POC can support nightly rotations and an HSM-backed key import ceremony.
jonathan_se: Can they accept our Dedicated offering with BYO-KMS (CloudHSM) or do they need on-prem HSM?
lisa_solutions: They specifically called out 'FIPS 140-2 Level 3' and 'no plaintext key material leaving their network' in the security questionnaire. sounds like either a customer HSM in their VPC or an HSM appliance. :thinking_face:
marco_security: Re: 'no plaintext leaving network' -> we can support key import via remote key ceremony and only transmit wrapped blobs. need to confirm their wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP? AES-KW?). also need their KMS endpoint IPs for allowlisting.
elaine_sales: Good — they're pushing for a 4-week POC window. First week: network + allowlist. Week 2: key import ceremony. Week 3: integration tests (rotate keys). Week 4: handoff + SOW. Is that feasible?
amanda_engineering: Feasible if they give infra access quickly. Rotation every 30 days is just a CRON trigger, but for HSM-backed imported keys we have to verify the import token TTLs. Also need to confirm we can schedule rotation without re-import (i.e., use a key-encryption-key hierarchy).
cory_support: Pricing note: BYOK with customer HSM incurs extra setup and hourly/egress for dedicated nodes. I'll pull the quote delta — typically +15-25% for HSM networking and ops.
jonathan_se: For the import ceremony we have a sample script. sending gist: https://internal.redwood/gists/key-import-demo (private). Also config snippet for allowlist: ```
# VPC egress rules
protocol: tcp
ports: 443
destinations:
  - 34.56.78.90/32  # redwood-managed endpoint
  - customer-kms-ip/32
```
marco_security: They'll need to complete section 3 of the security questionnaire about key custodians and split knowledge. ask them for the list of people who will hold HSM tokens. Without that we can't approve automated rotations.
lisa_solutions: Also flagging procurement timelines — customer legal needs the BYOK addendum + data processing addendum signed before on-prem connector goes live.
elaine_sales: Customer asked about key rotation audit logs and retention. we do provide detailed audit events and can forward logs to their SIEM via syslog or S3 (encrypted). is there any limitation on retention?
amanda_engineering: No hard limit on retention from our side for Dedicated; for Private deployments retention is customer-configurable. default 90 days in Hosted. We can export to their S3 for longer retention.
cory_support: I'll prepare an updated quote and a quick one-pager that maps security-questions -> implementation notes (HSM model, wrapping algorithms, rotation flow).
jonathan_se: Action items: 1) ask customer to confirm wrapping algorithm + list of key custodians (elaine) 2) legal to start BYOK addendum (lisa) 3) ops to prepare dedicated node quote and network allowlist (cory) 4) engineering to draft import demo + rotation runbook (amanda)
elaine_sales: I'll ping them now and push for a kickoff this Friday. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops_bot: Reminder: created POC workspace ticket #POC-4892 with tasks for network allowlist and import ceremony scheduling.
marco_security: If anything changes on FOIA/compliance side let me know. I want to review the import scripts before customer run.
elaine_sales: noted — marking security review as required for week 2.
